notes.title: DJMAX RESPECT V | SEASON 9 ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
DJMAX RESPECT V | SEASON 9 ANNOUNCEMENT


On April 27th, 2023, CLEAR PASS & LADDER MATCH Season 9 will start.
[previewyoutube=ThgEkkKw2VY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u]Ladder Match Season 9[/u][/h3]

Season 9 will start on April 27th, 2023, and run for 90 days, until July 27th, 2023.

[u][h3]Special rewards for LADDER MATCH SEASON 9 participants[/h3][/u]
At the end of SEASON 9, 100 randomly selected players, who have completed LADDER MATCH SEASON 9 placement matches, will receive acrylic standees as a prize!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/7bfc264b828e8ae3ade49ea16fc341c88a290799.png[/img]
Not only that, there will be a special reward for players who have achieved TOP 100 at the end of LADDER MATCH SEASON 9!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/6732955385564694535f5b96d25ca15af8690306.png[/img]
We will notify the winners at the end of the season.

(__NOTE: Merchandise can only be shipped to a valid South Korean address. We suggest international customers use a proxy-shipping service.__)

[h3][u]CLEAR PASS SEASON 9[/u][/h3]

Clear Pass Season 9 will start on April 27th. There will be various rewards, so please check it in-game after the Season begins.

CLEAR PASS: S9 PREMIUM TICKET will be released on Steam Market.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391270/DJMAX_RESPECT_V__CLEAR_PASS__S9_PREMIUM_TICKET/]Go to Store[/url]

[b][ CLEAR PASS : S9 PREMIUM TICKET Privilege ][/b]
Premium Ticket users will add a special badge in the plate profile.
CLEAR PASS S9 Ticket allows you to earn Premium Rewards and get Bonus Points when playing a game. (BONUS POINT earned: 100 -> 500)
Premium Ticket users can play any track the host selected in OPEN MATCH even if the user has not purchased the DLC. However, the user cannot select a DLC track that the user has not purchased when the user is the host.

CLEAR PASS: S9 CLEAR PASS BOOSTER will be released in Steam Market.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391271/DJMAX_RESPECT_V__CLEAR_PASS__S9_CLEAR_POINT_BOOSTER/]Go To Store[/url]
[b][ CLEAR PASS : S9 CLEAR PASS BOOSTER ][/b]
Clear Pass Booster allows users to earn 4x Clear Point during this season.
In addition to the Clear Point boosting effect, even if the user purchases Clear Pass Booster and does not reach STEP 30 by the end of the season, this product guarantee user to automatically step up to STEP 30. All the rewards that you did not claim after the season ends will be automatically sent to your account on the next season. 


[h3][u]Content Update[/u][/h3]

[b]New Track Update[/b]
Dark Lightning - AstroKid
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/491d064c1cdf3d0a90da581449fbe91898d3f3c8.png[/img]

[b]SC Pattern Update[/b]
54 SC patterns will be updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/76dd2c66454769f49c1b2ceddf53a76486bc0922.png[/img]

[b]EZ2ON PACK Content Update[/b]
Below 3 tracks and additional Note Skin will be added to EZ2ON PACK Content.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/81b8fd7b1b4032cebebcd045ef1c8dbd9bd24bef.png[/img]

[u][h3]Feature Update[/h3][/u]
1. The Collaboration tab is split into two sections:
[list]
[*] MUSIC GAME: Contains collaboration content with music games.
[*] VARIETY: Contains collaboration content with other genres.
[/list]

2. Player bots will participate in TEAM MATCH. If there aren't enough players, players can choose to allow bots to join. After approval, a member of the NB Rangers will join the game as a player bot. The skill level of the participating NB Ranger is randomly determined.

3. Keysound ON/OFF function will be added. The background music will play regardless of the player's timing. This is a recommended feature for players who are not familiar with the song. The ON/OFF setting for this feature can be changed at any time on the PAUSE screen and system settings screen.

4. Options that can be set on the PAUSE screen will be added:
[list]
[*] ON/OFF setting for BGA (background animation)
[*] Brightness adjustment for BGA (when ON)
[*] ON/OFF setting for Keysound
[/list]

5. The "BGA video ratio setting" function will be added to the system settings screen. Players can choose to display the output in full screen or maintain the original ratio.

6. The emoji display function will be available on the gamepad.


[h3][u]Modification and bug fix[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where mode-specific BGMs overlapped in the EZ2ON UI SKIN.
[*] Fixed an issue where the bottom UI was not displayed in the lobby of open matches.
[*] Changed the pattern image for the "Heartbeat SC."
[*] Fixed issue where "NB TITAN ~The Broken Heart~" achievement could not be earned.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/ad2c56fcfdaf6f30cfe30a957fe96cd0b82514a4.png[/img]

On January 18th, 2023, CLEAR PASS & LADDER MATCH Season 8 will start.

[previewyoutube=BcLlgYKNWpY;full][/previewyoutube]
For more details on Season 8, please check the below.

[h3][u]Ladder Match Season 8[/u][/h3]

Season 8 will start on January 18th, 2023, and run for 90 days, until April 17th, 2023.

[u][h3]Special rewards for LADDER MATCH SEASON 8 participants[/h3][/u]
At the end of SEASON 8, 100 randomly selected players, who have completed LADDER MATCH SEASON 8 placement matches, will receive acrylic standees as a prize!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/11f9b290595972d385cb4416d3b6c1741b692c8f.png[/img]

Acrylic Standee - AN IYOUNG (Sweet Ver.) - 40 Player
Acrylic Standee - EL CLEAR (Sweet Ver.) - 30 Player
Acrylic Standee - EL FAIL (Sweet Ver.) - 30 Player

Not only that, there will be a special reward for players who have achieved TOP 100 at the end of LADDER MATCH SEASON 8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/79f5f86eaa15b5f972859f46538fefcf9ed6b869.png[/img]

We will notify the winners at the end of the season.
To be eligible for both ladder match TOP 100 reward and raffle prize, please apply through the application linked below.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1l9FnubuAN_Do5xzUa9bYZ-15mh2rVFWqzVE_O21A6N0

(__NOTE: Merchandise can only be shipped to a valid South Korean address. We suggest international customers use a proxy-shipping service.__)

[h3][u]CLEAR PASS SEASON 8[/u][/h3]

Clear Pass Season 8 will start on January 18th. There will be various rewards, so please check it in-game after the Season begins.

CLEAR PASS: S8 PREMIUM TICKET will be released on Steam Market.

[b][ CLEAR PASS : S8 PREMIUM TICKET Privilege ][/b]
Premium Ticket users will add a special badge in the plate profile.
CLEAR PASS S8 Ticket allows you to earn Premium Rewards and get Bonus Points when playing a game. (BONUS POINT earned : 100 -> 500)
Premium Ticket users can play any track the host selected in OPEN MATCH even if the user has not purchased the DLC. However, the user cannot select a DLC track that the user has not purchased when the user is the host.

CLEAR PASS : S8 CLEAR PASS BOOSTER will be released in Steam Market.

[b][ CLEAR PASS : S8 CLEAR PASS BOOSTER ][/b]
Clear Pass Booster allows users to earn 4x Clear Point during this season.
In addition to the Clear Point boosting effect, even if the user purchases Clear Pass Booster and does not reach STEP 30 by the end of the season, this product guarantee user to automatically step up to STEP 30. All the rewards that you did not claim after the season ends will be automatically sent to your account on the next season. 


[h3][u]Content Update[/u][/h3]

[b]New Track Update[/b]
Planetboom - Dancin' Planet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/a72402913ba427c8725c4e676acd3c9de1934d5f.png[/img]

50 SC patterns will be updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/ab595ce32d83d7e5b541a2301ae6347467a14412.png[/img]
[u][h3]Feature Update[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Open Match - VERSUS feature has been updated.[/b]
[list]
[*] This is a mode where you can play 1vs1 with the same rule as Ladder Match.
[*] Other participants in the room can observe the Versus Match.
[*] Observers can communicate in-game by chatting.
[/list]

[b]2. Open Match Enter System Modified[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can enter the proceeding room (if not full) and wait for the game to end.
[/list]

[b]3. Emoticon usage has been expanded[/b]
[list]
[*] You can use emoji that you did not save as a hotkey.
[*] You can press [8] to select emoji in your inventory and send it.
[/list]
[b]4. Rich Presence feature has been added in Steam and Discord[/b]

[b]5. Game Opening has been changed.[/b]


[h3][u]Modification and bug fix[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can turn ON/OFF Rate in Mission Practice Mode.
[*] Fixed issue where Tic! Tac! Toe! information in Collection was shown out of the area.
[*] Fixed issue where some MV sounds did not play in Collection.
[*] Disabled DPC2022 Event Hotkey (F7) in Mode Selection.
[*] Fixed issue where some thumbnails were not shown properly in Collection.
[*] Fixed issue where some information was shown abnormally in Collection - M/V.
[*] Fixed issue where NVIDIA REFLEX Setting went back to initial settings when the game restarts.
[*] Fixed issue where vsync setting is automatically turned ON when using Steam Deck
[*] FMOD Engine Update
[*] Fixed issue where score difference was not shown in some gears.
[*] Fixed issue where Mouse cursor was shown in the game.

[/list]

notes.title: DJMAX RESPECT V | DPC2022 Update (August 11th KST)
notes.content:
DJMAX RESPECT V | DPC2022 Update Announcement

A new client update v1217 is being pushed out for DJMAX RESPECT V on Aug 11, 2022 14:00 KST. No server maintenance will be performed for this update. You must update to the latest game client in order to play. 
There has been a minor issue where an error pop-up comes out when you first try to enter DPC2022 Mode.
It will work normally after re-trying to enter.
Sorry for the inconvenience.

<DPC2022 FINAL CHALLENGE>

DPC2022 "Final Challenge" will start from August 11th, 2022.
To begin, here are the final challengers :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/67a94269a3ce6f1645e8a48bcdd37f0c1a2418e9.png[/img]

After an update on August 11th, all users will be a judge and will be able to play and rate the patterns of the Final Challengers.
Here are some guidelines :

◆ Final Challenge will process until August 26th, 23:59 KST. Date may change with prior notice.

◆ After the game starts, you can enter DPC2022 Mode by pressing F7.

◆ Creators of DPC2022 patterns will not be shown in the Game, therefore we have numbered a random number to each pattern.

◆ After completing each pattern, you can rate the patterns, and playing DPC2022 patterns will not give any in-game rewards including level or clear pass points.

◆ You can change your rating after playing the same pattern again.

◆ Total of 8 Winners will be selected by user and judge rating through Final Challenge.
- 1st Prize  : 3,000,000 KRW
- 2nd Prize : 1,000,000 KRW
- 3rd Prize :  500,000 KRW
- Special Prize (5 ppl) :  100,000 KRW per each winner
(※ Some of winning patterns may not be serviced in game.)

◆ In DPC2022 Mode, there will not be GAME OVER so you can freely play each pattern until the end.

◆ All patterns will be serviced as they are exactly submitted. Therefore, some patterns may be unable to be played with MAX COMBO or somewhat impossible placement.

◆ If we find any final challengers or possible associates who are promoting a certain pattern in SNS or community, we will consider it as abusing and will be removed from Final Challenge.

Thank you for your interest in DPC2022.

* v1217 Bug fixe
- Fixed "Retention" Plate name 
- Changed Restart Text in Japanese Language environment.
- Fixed text box UI for some languages
- Fixed an issue where key assignments were incorrect when playing TB mode to the game pad
- Fixed an issue with unusually high update capacity on Steam Deck

Thank you.

notes.title: DJMAX RESPECT V | v1191 Update Announcement (No maintenance)
notes.content:
v1191 Update Announcement (No maintenance)

A new client update v1191 is being pushed out for DJMAX RESPECT V on June 30, 2022 14:00 KST. No server maintenance will be performed for this update. You must update to the latest game client in order to play. 

Feature Additions and Improvements
1. Master Volume Settings
-You can now adjust game master volume settings in the game system settings (F10)

2. Additional Keyboard Bindings
-Resolved an issue where Right Alt key could not be used for gameplay 
-Resolved an issue where Numpad Enter input would not register

3. Refined Cursor Movement System
-Adjusted the input handling of Page Up/Down keys for navigation
-You can now hold down Page Up/Down keys to quickly navigate the cursor

4. Adjusted unlock condition for the BLACK SQUARE DLC Achievement "The toughest difficulty in the DJMAX series" 
-Played difficulty 15 SC patterns of BLACK SQUARE → Played an SC difficulty pattern from BLACK SQUARE

5. Emoticon shortcut keys are no longer displayed if the user input for emoticon keys has been changed from default

6. Adjusted Open Match Action Emoticon Behavior
-Break Action Emoticon will now only trigger when a break occurs after obtaining a combo of 100

*Bug fixed
-Fixed an issue where emoticons were not properly displayed during ladder matches on the right side gear.
-Fixed an issue in the Freestyle controller menu where UI elements were misaligned.
-Fixed an issue where the Plate would incorrectly expand while the cursor was hovering over FEVER SOUND / CLEAR SOUND selection on the Inventory Screen.
-Fixed an unusual stray pixel on the Ladder Match Lobby screen.
-Fixed an issue where emoticons would appear abnormally when the Equipment menu is opened during a Ladder Match.
-Fixed an issue where some equipped gears would appear abnormally in the Judgement Time Adjustment Test Play screen.
-Fixed an issue where Open Match rooms could not be entered if the room changed locations after becoming enterable. 
-Fixed an issue where animated Plates would restart their animation when a player changed their difficulty in Open Match.
-Fixed an issue where some V EXTENSION II achievements were not earned when meeting the proper achievement conditions.
-Fixed an issue with inputs not registering properly with Japanese 109-key keyboards.
- VEXTENSION II Achievement Fix errors not achieved.
- Fixed an error in the Japanese 109 keyboard environment where no input or other keys responded.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update Preview - January 28th
notes.content:
The first season of DJMAX RESPECT V’s ladder match will be starting from 4PM, January 28th (KST).

The season will start after the update that will process at the announced time and it will process for 90 days.
With the start of the season, DJMAX RESPECT V’s first battle pass, CLEAR PASS system will be added as well as 2 free tracks and additional patterns of 11 tracks.

If you wish to check out details of the January 28th Update, please check the details below.
Also, we updated the patch note video with the voice of jam-jam, so don’t miss out!
[previewyoutube=Htn1TXp4hFY;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][h3]LADDER MATCH SEASON 1 CHANGES[/h3][/u]

[b]TIER SYSTEM CHANGE[/b]
- Tiers were divided by buttons in Pre-season. In Season system 1, all button tiers will be united to 1 tier system.
- Button selection by tier has been newly added

[b]PRE-MATCHING : BUTTON SELECTION BY TIER[/b]
- Unranked ~ Gold tier users have to activate at least 1 button to start matching.
- Platinum ~ Diamond 2 tier user tier users have to activate at least 2 buttons to start matching.
- Diamond 1 ~ Grandmaster tier users will have to activate all buttons to start matching.
- The ladder match starts with the button enabled for both matching users.

[b]LOBBY UI DESIGN[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/4f414c5bcd08e4bedd5efde9d6ff3d0b6adf5210.png[/img]
- My tier, tier emblem, and LP will now show in the lobby.
- The design has been refined.

[b]4. HISTORY DESIGN CHANGE[/b]


[h3]CLEAR PASS SEASON 1[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/a44593ddda7056db09fe7a3776b57ed496822ce2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/c0e42db657490e525c64f025dad3bdaffe81628f.png[/img]

- Now you can earn CLEAR POINT while playing DJMAX RESPECT V. Collect CLEAR POINT (CP) and earn additional decorative contents. You can enter CLEAR PASS PAGE by pressing F6 in the Mode/Song Selection page.
- You can earn CP after clearing a song. However, you cannot earn CP in AIR MODE.  Each mode gives you different CP, so try various modes of DJMAX RESPECT V!
- The reward is divided into FREE/PREMIUM rewards. You can earn a Premium Reward after buying Premium Pass in the Steam market. Premium Pass also gives extra CP if bought.
- CLEAR PASS Season 1 will only process for 90 days, same as Ladder Match Season 1.
- You can check out all list of rewards of Clear Pass in the game after the update.

[u][h3]CONTENT UPDATE[/h3][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/8bb1b63aa7f4d285089a674a7227db7115573a51.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/6108ed80a9c48a80c9730e1d996c7c384d319c34.png[/img]

Dance of the Dead - GOTH and Karma - Dareharu will be updated in RESPECT tab.

notes.title: PRE-ANNOUNCEMENT - DJMAX RESPECT FULL RELEASE UPDATE NOTE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36307828/23a6053edea01ac9b3411529d0c169bbd368cfc0.png[/img]


Hello, this is from Rocky Studio.
We are preparing for our full release which will happen on March 12th.
Here are some update notes for the full release.

 

[h2][b]OPENING LADDER MATCH PRE-SEASON [/b][/h2]
[list][*][b] PLACEMENT MATCH HAVE BEEN ADDED[/b][olist][*] For each button mode, you will face BOT for the first 5 matches to get placed.[*] Each match against a bot will give you a BP (Placement Point), and after 5 matches, you will be placed.[*] Please check the list of tiers you can get placed with placement match.
- Iron 1, 2, 3, 4
- Bronze 1, 2, 3, 4
- Silver 1, 2, 3, 4
- Gold 1, 2, 3, 4
- Platinum 1, 2, 3, 4 [/olist] [/list][list]
[*] [b]CHANGED ROUND SYSTEM[/b][olist][*] REMATCH system for the first 2 rounds has been removed, and we minimized game rounds.
[*] If the match score is tied for the first two rounds (either 1:1 or 2:2), players will proceed with the final round in the hard judgment.
[*] If two players tie in the final match, TIE-BREAKER will process with even harder judgment.
[*] We have added rules when tie happens in a match.
[*] Please check the below for the tie-rule.
[*] Draw in a Round will grant each player a point. (example below:)
 - First Round Win / Second Round Draw -> Winner of the First Round wins the match.
 - First Round Draw / Second Round Win -> Winner of the Second Round wins the match.
 - First Round Draw / Second Round Draw -> Final Round starts with hard judgment.
 - First Round Win / Second Round Lose -> Final Round starts with hard judgment. [/olist][/list][list]
[*] [b]RELEGATION SYSTEM ADDED[/b][olist][*] LADDER MATCH BETA didn't have a proper relegation system. We fixed it. [/olist] [/list][list] [*] [b]PROMOTION MATCH CHANGED[/b] [olist][*] The promotion match has been simplified up to Platinum rank. (1 win out of two matches)
[*] Diamond / Master tier's promotion matches are still the best of 5.
[*] UI has been added for the promotion and relegation. [/olist][/list][list][*] [b]BOT PLACEMENT HAS BEEN CHANGED[/b][olist][*] You can no longer meet a PENGUIN BOT in Platinum tier.[/olist][/list][list][*][b]UI DESIGN CHANGED AND ENHANCED[/b]
[*] [b]DESIGN FOR GAME READY STATUS HAS BEEN CHANGED[/b]
[*] [b]NOW YOU CAN SEE THE OPPONENT'S GEARS/NOTES[/b]
[*] [b]BUG FIX AND FEATURE ENHANCEMENT[/b][olist][*]Fixed issue where the game crashed or worked inappropriately when the opponent leaves in the middle of the match.[*] Now you can earn rewards and experience points in a ladder match.[/olist][/list]
 
[h2][b]MISSION MODE OPEN[/b][/h2][list][*] Now you can experience 60 renewed missions of RESPECT.[*] Added 12 missions for V EXTENSION PACK. (V EXTENSION MISSION has to be purchased to unlock.)[/list]
 
[h2][b]SCORE AND FEVER SYSTEM[/b] [/h2][list][*] Now all perfect play will have the same score.[*] The maximum score you can get from FEVER OFF has been changed to 350,000 from 300,000.[*] FEVER changed to give bonus score when it is activated.[*] Previous Ranking Board and Personal Scores will not be removed.[/list]
 
[b][h2]ADDED STEAM ACHIEVEMENT[/h2][/b][list][*] Added 52 RESPECT V Steam Achievements.[*] Added 9 V EXTENSION Achievements.[*] V EXTENSION Achievements can be acquired after purchasing DLC.[/list]
 
[b][h2]LOCALIZATION[/h2][/b][list][*] Added languages.
[*] This localization is the first one of many to come. In a few features, the menu and texts may be English for now.
[*] The features that are not localized yet, will be changed after additional updates.
[*] Please check the added languages below:
- JAPANESE
- CHINESE (SIMPLIFIED/TRADITIONAL)
- GERMAN
- SPANISH (LA/EUROPE)
- FRENCH
- PORTUGESE
- RUSSIAN[/list]

[b][h2]EXPANDED USER LEVEL[/h2][/b][list][*] The maximum user-level now changed from 99 to 999.[*] AIR MODE will only give experience to 99.[/list]
 
These changes will apply at our full release on March 12th.
We will keep up with our updates and try our best to give you the best experience.
Thank you.

notes.title: v291 Introduce Ladder Match
notes.content:
[b] Thank you for participating DJMAX RESPECT V LADDER MATCH [BETA].
Please check the following information.[/b]

1. Ladder Match is a mode in which players who have similar skills are given a rank in a 1:1 competition.

2. You can find the basic play guide of Ladder Match in HELP. 
(DJMAX RESPECT V - Online Mode - LADDER MATCH)

3. First 5 matches of each button, you will be matched against a BOT to determine your skill. After that, you will be primarily matched against an actual player but if there has been no matching after certain period of time, you will be matched against a BOT of the appropriate tier.  When you surpass Diamond Tier, you will not be able to play against a BOT anymore.

4. If two players complete a round as a tie, there will be a re-match with harder judgment. Until the winner of the round is decided, this process will repeat.

notes.title: V177 Update
notes.content:
V177 Update
1. Song Update
     # Porter Robinson - Sad machine
     # Virtual Self - Ghost Voices
2. Scores won't be saved in the AIR mode.
3. Fixed a problem where exp wasn't being stacked in the AIR mode when using AUTO PLAY feature.
4. Target Monitor setting feature deleted in the system settings.
5. Opening music volume adjusted.
6. Fixed a bug where the game didn't proceed after displaying the photosensitive epilepsy warning.
    # In order to fix this bug, click the right button of the mouse on "DJMAX RESPECT V" inside the Steam library list. Then choose the "Properties" option, and click the "Set launch options..." under the "General" tab. Finally, type in the code "-skip_browser".

-Please update the game to apply the changes.
